Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.268 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Bihar, District Unnao.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years was enticed by the applicant.

The radiological age of the victim was tentatively 17 years.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and the tentative age of the victim is around 17 years coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 31.01.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
